votes.motion: Adopt Joint Resolution 42 of 2024, recognizing December 1, 2024, as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: Ceremonial resolution jointly adopted with Mayor Mendenhall to officially recognize December 1st as World AIDS Day in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 and B-2 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on two grant applications (PRO Housing Grant and Community Forest Corps/Urban Forestry Fellowship) and refers them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Jordan River Fairpark District Zoning Map & Text Amendment to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on the proposed Jordan River Fairpark (JRF) zoning district and development agreement to allow additional time for review and negotiation before action is taken.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Ordinance for Temporary Closure of a Portion of 1000 West to a future Council meeting
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on the proposed ordinance temporarily closing a segment of 1000 West between South Temple and 15 South 1000 West, due to noticing issues, to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 87 of 2024 (Street and Alley Vacation and Subdivision Amendment at Brooklyn Avenue)
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance vacating a portion of Brooklyn Avenue and an adjacent City-owned alley, with the vacated parcels to be sold at fair market value to adjacent property owners at 1005 and 1007 South 500 West.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 86 of 2024 (Zoning Map Amendment at 1816 South State Street)
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance rezoning the property at approximately 1816 South State Street from BP (Business Park) to CC (Corridor Commercial) to allow for additional commercial uses, supported by the Central Community Master Plan.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 41 of 2024, the Salt Lake City Public Utilities Revenue Bonds, Series 2025 parameters resolution, and refer to the consent agenda for setting the date for a public hearing on the bond issuance for December 3, 2024
votes.description: Adopts a parameters resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of up to $225,000,000 in Public Utilities revenue bonds to finance water and sewer capital improvements, including the City Creek Water Treatment Plant and a new water reclamation facility.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 89 of 2024, approving a $250,000 loan for HK Brewing Collective, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $250,000 EDLF loan to HK Brewing Collective, LLC at 307 Aspen Avenue to support job creation and retention at a non-alcoholic kombucha brewery and taproom.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 88 of 2024, approving a $250,000 loan for GK Folks Foundation from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: Approves a $250,000 EDLF loan to GK Folks Foundation at 1506 South Redwood Road to create a community events center for African immigrants and refugees and support job creation and retention.

Approves the consent agenda, which includes setting the public hearing date of December 3, 2024 for the Public Utilities Revenue Bonds Series 2025 parameters resolution and Budget Amendment No. 2 for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
